funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage in their career; must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research in British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; up to £8,000 for any stage, £8,001‑£20,000 for postdoctoral level or above.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research travel and/or dedicated research time in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or about to start a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides a fixed £5,000 to support students beginning or continuing their postgraduate studies.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country.
opportunities.summary: Supports research trips to examine eighteenth- and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a master’s degree at a UK institution, start between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding (up to £32,000) for a one‑year master’s degree (or split over two years part‑time) in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a doctorate at a UK institution, start between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees may differ).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £96,000 total to cover tuition and living costs for a three‑year doctorate in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Supports an in‑depth research project in British art, with funding of £35,000 (one year) or £70,000 (two years).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree (pre‑doctoral to senior level).
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium for research on British‑Italian topics.
